name: openspeedtest
title: OpenSpeedTest
description: OpenSpeedTest measures download, upload, ping and jitter between a browser and this server, with nothing to install on the device. It keeps no data and has no settings. Open it by IP address and port for a true reading: behind a reverse proxy the proxy's upload limit and buffering change the result.
